title: Flattening and asymptotic orthogonalization of completely positive maps
summary: Let $M$ be a $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor, $N$ a tracial von Neumann algebra, and $Φ: M \rightarrow N$ a subtracial completely positive map. For an irreducible $\mathrm{II}_1$ subfactor $P \subseteq M$, we characterize when $Φ$ exhibits a flattening property under conjugation by unitaries in $P$. To be specific, we show that the failure of a Pimsner-Popa type inequality for $E_P \circ Φ^* \circ Φ$ is the precise obstruction, equivalently characterized by left weak mixing of a naturally associated $P$-$N$ bimodule.
